page.content:
The clade Richard Owen named in 1842 for the 'fearfully great reptiles.'

How Dinosauria connects

  • Topic: Dinosaurs — Dinosauria is the formal clade behind the public subject of dinosaurs.
  • Character: Richard Owen — Richard Owen coined the name Dinosauria in 1842.
  • Topic: Saurischia — Saurischia is one of the two great branches of Dinosauria.
  • Topic: Ornithischia — Ornithischia is the bird-hipped branch of Dinosauria.
  • Event: K–Pg extinction — The K–Pg extinction ended non-avian members of Dinosauria.
  • Item: Iguanodon — Iguanodon was one of the three genera Owen used to define Dinosauria.

What is Dinosauria?

Dinosauria is the formal clade that unites ornithischians and saurischians — later refined so that birds sit inside theropod dinosaurs rather than beside them.

Key threads lead to Dinosaurs, Richard Owen, Saurischia, Ornithischia, K–Pg extinction and Iguanodon.
